_sources.listing: Google Business Profile, read in the user's own Chrome via Claude in Chrome (2026-11-28): 'Sunraysia Handywork', 5.0 stars, 7 reviews (all 5 stars), category 'Handyman/Handywoman/Handyperson', closes 8 PM, phone +61 448 916 399 (matches the sheet), Mildura, no website ('Add website'). A second listing with the same name and phone also shows 5.0/7 (closes 6 PM) and a third has no reviews (Fifteenth St); this page uses the first. Cover photo: a carport/verandah area beside red brick under blue sky.
_sources.services: From reviews: new kitchen cupboards, breakfast bar top and side bar installed; small carpentry job; general handyman work, on time and at a fair price. Owner named Ali in reviews.
_sources.brand: No brand online. Taken from their Google listing cover photo (red brick and blue sky) with scripts/sample-brand.mjs, adjusted by eye: primary = brick #a1432d (white 6.3:1), dark = #161616 (white 18.1:1), accent = sky blue #8cc4ef (9.7:1 on dark). Sampled from their listing photo, not an official brand; confirm with the owner. Concept mark (rising sun over a plank, for Sunraysia) is original.
_sources.reviews: Google Reviews tab, same session: 7 reviews, all 5 stars (5 with text); 3 complete ones copied verbatim (Joanne Camilleri: kitchen cupboards, Jay F: general job, Alan Wishart: small carpentry job).

gap: No website and duplicate listings: 5.0 stars on Google but 'Add website', plus three separate 'Sunraysia Handywork' listings that split the reviews, so people in Mildura can only ring and may not know which listing is current.
